Help/Fixing a capture/No usable photos

No usable photos were saved

The capture reached Veylet with fewer than three usable photos, so nothing could be built. The fix is to walk slowly and turn a full circle at each spot, so Veylet can save photos as you go.

  1. Capture the room again with the lights on.
  2. Hold the phone upright and point it at a corner or door frame until views start saving.
  3. Walk slowly and turn a full circle at each spot, waiting for each view to save.
  4. Finish, check the phone check says Ready to send, then tap Send to Veylet.

If it doesn’t work

If the phone check says Not enough views yet, fewer than three photos were saved. Hold the phone level on a clear corner or doorway until views start saving.

If the camera view stays black or frozen, close the app fully, open it again and retry.

Recapturing won’t use a walkthrough.

Still stuck? Email Veylet support

Write to yoda@yodalai.xyz and a person replies. Say which step you were on, your iPhone or iPad model, and the app version from Account, then About. Never send passwords or sign-in links.
